name: Builder Agent v1.1.0 Decision lifecycle regression
description: Redacted Builder regression for a material product Decision, deterministic apply-before-complete lifecycle, current Live Context, transparent stream output and concept usage without a learning verdict.

criteria.description: The confirmed Spec, Task, final Context and Completion Report satisfy strict contracts.
criteria.successDefinition: Every T11 durable record passes runtime validation.

criteria.description: The final Context is current and includes the concepts used by the build.
criteria.successDefinition: Context version and active concepts match the fixture expectation.

criteria.description: The user-visible transient stream contains no credential sentinel or host user path.
criteria.successDefinition: No forbidden sentinel or user-home path remains.

criteria.description: Concept usage reports implementation facts without claiming that the user learned them, and excluded work remains absent.
criteria.successDefinition: A reviewer finds no false mastery or excluded-scope implementation claim.

criteria.description: The Builder interrupts only for a material product behavior choice and carries the applied Decision into completion.
criteria.successDefinition: The Decision changes user-visible validation behavior, is not a reversible internal detail, and appears in appliedDecisionIds.
